title: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion
abstract: arXiv:2610.41574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unlike autoregressive (AR) models, diffusion language models (DLMs) permit parallel token updates, flexible generation, and bidirectional attention, but leading systems rely on costly pretraining or full-model fine-tuning. We present Build Your Own DLM (BYOD), a generalizable LoRA-only recipe for parameter-efficient AR-to-DLM conversion. Without architecture-specific tuning, BYOD induces diffusion generation in Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B, and Ministral 8B; to our knowledge, this is the first reported AR-to-DLM conversion of a Mistral model. The adapters comprise 4.1-5.8% of final parameters while every base-model parameter remains frozen; each 25,000-iteration conversion needs at most 102.4M tokens, processed in 3.1-4.0 hours on one Google Colab GPU. translated_title: BYOD：构建你自己的扩散语言模型——高效的自回归到扩散语言模型转换
translated_abstract: 与自回归（AR）模型不同，扩散语言模型（DLM）允许并行词元更新、灵活生成和双向注意力，但现有的领先系统依赖于高昂的预训练或全模型微调。我们提出了Build Your Own DLM（BYOD），这是一种可泛化的仅使用LoRA的方案，用于参数高效的自回归到扩散语言模型转换。无需针对特定架构进行调整，BYOD即可在Gemma 2 9B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen2.5 7B和Ministral 8B上诱导出扩散式生成；据我们所知，这是首次报道的对Mistral模型进行AR到DLM的转换。这些适配器仅占最终参数的4.1-5.8%，而所有基础模型参数保持冻结；每次25,000次迭代的转换最多仅需1.024亿个词元，在一块Google Colab GPU上耗时3.1-4.0小时。所有四个模型都能从完全遮蔽的序列开始生成，在受控注意力测试中使用双向上下文，并保留了大量的母模型知识。BYOD-Gemma是最……（原文截断）
tldr: BYOD提出了一种仅用LoRA适配器的可泛化方案，能在单块GPU上数小时内将Gemma、Llama、Qwen、Mistral等自回归语言模型低成本转换为扩散语言模型，同时冻结全部基础模型参数并保留原模型知识。
en_tdlr: BYOD introduces a generalizable LoRA-only recipe that efficiently converts autoregressive language models (Gemma, Llama, Qwen, Mistral) into diffusion language models in hours on a single GPU, keeping all base-model parameters frozen while preserving parent-model knowledge.
